rationale: The DEFAULT-STATE (flag-off) half of the citation-claim contract: `BB_DART_CITATION` is off in the committed arm, so a listed bare name must carry NO `languageNamespace` metadata. This is the byte-identical-off pin — the flag-ON half (claims present, policy present, unlisted/lowercase unmarked, drift assertion) lives in script/m14/dart-citation-fixtures.ts because the fixture runner cannot set a per-fixture flag. Running THIS fixture with BB_DART_CITATION=1 would fail by design: the committed arm does not set the flag.

expectRelationships.note: LISTED annotation, flag off: the annotation reference exists and carries NO claim metadata.

forbidRelationships.note: the flag-off state must not claim.
